name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) is a Centrally Sponsored flagship scheme of the Ministry of Women and Child Development designed to provide maternity benefits to pregnant women and lactating mothers belonging to socially and economically disadvantaged sections. PMMVY 2.0, implemented under Mission Shakti and effective from 01 April 2022, provides an additional incentive of ₹6,000 in one instalment for the second child if the second child is a girl.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefits: First child: ₹5,000 total PMMVY maternity benefit in two instalments, with the source stating the beneficiary may also receive JSY cash incentive after institutional delivery so that on average a woman receives ₹6,000.
First instalment: ₹3,000 on registration of pregnancy and at least one antenatal check-up within six months from LMP at an Anganwadi Centre or approved health facility.
Second instalment: ₹2,000 after childbirth registration and after the child receives all due vaccines up to 14 weeks as admissible under the Universal Immunization Programme.

Second child if the second child is a girl: ₹6,000 in one instalment after birth, subject to pregnancy registration, ANC within six months from LMP, girl-child birth registration and due vaccinations up to 14 weeks.
In case of miscarriage or stillbirth, the beneficiary is treated as a fresh beneficiary for any future pregnancy.
The scheme aims to promote positive behavioural change towards the girl child and contribute to improving Sex Ratio at Birth.

rules.description: The applicant must belong to a socially or economically disadvantaged category listed in the supplied source. Categories include SC, ST, women with 40%+ disability, BPL ration card holders, PM-JAY beneficiaries, e-Shram card holders, women farmers receiving Kisan Samman Nidhi, MGNREGA Job Card holders, women with net family income below ₹8 lakh per year, pregnant or lactating AWW/AWH/ASHA workers, NFSA ration-card holders, and any other category prescribed by the Central Government.
Applicant should be a pregnant woman.
Applicant should be at least 19 years old.
The supplied source states that the applicant should be employed and experiencing wage-loss due to pregnancy.
Eligible beneficiary can apply within 270 days from childbirth according to the supplied source.

The supplied source states that the scheme provides maternity benefits for the first child and, under PMMVY 2.0, for the second child if the second child is a girl. It also contains wording that the scheme is applicable only for the first live birth. Preserve this source terminology without resolving the inconsistency.

exclusion_rules.description: Pregnant women and lactating mothers in regular employment with the Central Government, State Government or Public Sector Undertaking, or those receiving similar benefits under any law, are not entitled to PMMVY benefits.

documents.description: Aadhaar-mapped bank or post office account for direct benefit transfer.
Bank account details of the applicant.

Evidence of belonging to a disadvantaged category. The supplied source lists acceptable evidence including income below ₹8 lakh, MGNREGA Job Card, Kisan Samman Nidhi beneficiary proof, e-Shram card, PM-JAY beneficiary proof, BPL ration card, disability proof, SC/ST proof, AWW/AWH/ASHA proof, and NFSA ration card.
Mother and Child Protection or Reproductive and Child Health Inventory card.
Record of Last Menstrual Period date.
Details of child immunization up to 14 weeks under the Universal Immunization Programme.

tutorial_steps.title: Visit the PMMVY portal
tutorial_steps.description: Visit the official PMMVY website at https://pmmvy.wcd.gov.in/.

tutorial_steps.title: Click Citizen Login
tutorial_steps.description: Click the Citizen Login option on the PMMVY portal.

tutorial_steps.title: Enter and verify mobile number
tutorial_steps.description: Enter your mobile number and complete the verification process.

tutorial_steps.title: Enter personal and location details
tutorial_steps.description: Enter full name, State, District, Area, Block, Village and relationship with beneficiary.

tutorial_steps.title: Create the account
tutorial_steps.description: Create the user account with the required credentials.

tutorial_steps.title: Log in to the portal
tutorial_steps.description: Log in using User ID, password and captcha.

tutorial_steps.title: Open Beneficiary Registration
tutorial_steps.description: Navigate to Data Entry and select Beneficiary Registration.

tutorial_steps.title: Enter personal information
tutorial_steps.description: Enter detailed personal information as required in the registration form.

tutorial_steps.title: Choose child order option
tutorial_steps.description: Choose First Child or Second Child under the scheme application option.

tutorial_steps.title: Complete all required form details
tutorial_steps.description: Complete all required form details including eligibility, Aadhaar and bank information.

tutorial_steps.title: Ensure payment and contact information
tutorial_steps.description: Ensure Aadhaar-based payment information and mobile number are available for application-status and disbursement communication.
